scalar_convention: Sum m=-2,+2 within each population BEFORE extrema, endpoints and comparisons; populations remain separate.
field_norm_definition: sqrt(sum over m=-2,+2 and n=0..6 of (-D_n)*abs(c_mn)^2); no half factor, no summing coefficients across m. For a projected field this norm squared equals -2 times its summed diagonal field energy.
field_norm_scope: Wake and stage/current residual norms use the same negative-Poisson metric. They are not work/energy allowances; current norms have an additional inverse-time unit. Cross-case norms apply to coefficient differences, not differences of norms; scalar field-energy differences are not the energy of the coefficient difference.
units: G=M_total=b=1; work/energy are quadratic coefficients in perturbation amplitude epsilon; wake coefficients are first-order responses.
limits: All three original complete histories remain at their native clocks; halfdt differences select only exact common clocks without interpolation.
Raw budgets, individual signed sectors, all seven field coefficients and phase/time differences are retained; no caller subtraction, fitting, renormalization or endpoint selection.
Phase refinement and timestep refinement are separate finite comparisons, not an error bound or proof of stationarity. No energy/eta action refinement is performed.
Stationary kernel and simultaneous path share DF, nodes, profiles, background, angular contraction and energy formula; agreement is not independent continuum validation.
Only the projected seven-field self-energy is measured; omitted channels and finite quadrature integration-by-parts errors remain.
The three matched parents must be successful original owners. No recovery exception, pilot substitution, missing-case fallback or automatic continuation is supported.
